title: विक्रीची किमान मर्यादा
caption: मोठ्या दुकानापूर्वी, आशाला तिने कमीत कमी किती विकले पाहिजे हे जाणून घ्यायचे आहे. लुमी तिची गोष्ट सांगते.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, in the free month or on a paid plan, the Break-even calculator takes monthly fixed costs, sales and the cost of what is sold, and shows how much must be sold each month to cover costs and the safety margin above that line. It is maths on the owner's own numbers, not a forecast.

cast.asha: Asha, a young Indian woman planning a bigger bakery, in a yellow cotton kurta with a thin gold necklace

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a small neat bakery with warm light and fresh bread behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: हाय, मी लुमी. ही आशाची गोष्ट आहे. तिला एक मोठं बेकरी आणि जास्त भाडे हवंय.
